name: Demon Bluff
description:
About This Game

The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

A ROGUELIKE CARD GAME WHERE YOUR DECK IS FULL OF LIES

Demon Bluff combines the tension of social deduction games with the replay value of a single-player roguelike deckbuilder.

Your goal is to investigate a corrupted village, gather information from each character, and piece together the truth to uncover and slay every demon in hiding.

Each character is represented by a card - Villager and Outcast cards will help you track them down with information and unique abilities. But be careful -  Demons and Minions have disguised themselves as Villagers and will try to mislead you. Will you be able to see through their lies?

MANY MODES TO MASTER

Face the lies and save multiple corrupted villages in one run, with an expanding deck of randomized cards. Or, draft your own in Deckbuilding mode - then conquer a multi-part run where you’ll encounter new and increasingly complex cards, upgrades, and lies as you progress. Plus - test yourself with endless mode, challenges, and more.

EXPAND, UNLOCK, AND CUSTOMIZE

Keep saving villages and unlock dozens of new character cards to expand your deck or encounter in randomized runs. Then, customize them with alternate skins, card backs, and decorations you’ll collect as you play.

FEATURES:

  • 100+ unique character cards to collect

  • Cosmetic unlocks and customization

  • Increasingly complex mechanics and challenges

  • Multiple modes and scenarios to encounter and master

  • And remember - THE CARDS LIE.
